{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'loyal' in customer_segment
print("Unique customer_segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check status values
print("Unique status values:", sales['status'].unique())

# Inspect revenue column type and sample values
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))

# Check for customer_age sentinel -1
age_sentinel = sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1]
print("Number of customer_age == -1:", len(age_sentinel))"}
